item.title: What Do You Really Want? | John 5:2-14 | Ryan Abraham
item.description:
In the sermon "What Do You Really Want?", Pastor Ryan delivers a powerful message about the transformative nature of choosing to follow Jesus completely. He encourages you to embrace the change that comes with a life committed to Christ, reminding us that while we may feel stuck in our current season, God is a way maker who meets us in our weakness to bring healing and new purpose. It’s a heartening call to step out of spiritual complacency and experience the supernatural joy and freedom that only a full surrender to Him can provide. item.title: FAMILY MATTERS | Please Stop the Bleeding | Genesis 29-32 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
In this sermon, Pastor Steve encourages families to "stop the bleeding" by addressing the deep pain that can often occur within family units. He highlights that while family struggles are difficult, there is hope and healing through repentance, letting go of the need for control, and choosing the path of forgiveness. Ultimately, he invites you to release any past hurts to the Lord, trusting that His grace can restore relationships and bring a "family revival" to your home. item.title: FAMILY MATTERS | Built to Last | Matthew 7:24-27 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
This powerful message reminds us that while storms in life are inevitable, building our foundation on the "Rock" of Jesus Christ ensures we remain standing through every trial. By putting God’s word into practice, we can move from sinking sand to a place of sure blessing, finding peace and strength even in the midst of chaos. It's a motivating call to trust in God’s faithfulness to sustain and protect your family, marriage, and future. item.title: A Resurrected Heart | Ephesians 4:27-30 | Bernie Federmann
item.description:
In this sermon, guest speaker Bernie Federmann delivers a powerful message about the weight our words carry and the importance of a "resurrected heart." He encourages us to guard our hearts against negativity and to intentionally speak life-giving words that build others up. Ultimately, he reminds us that since our words reveal the condition of our hearts, we should fill ourselves with God’s truth to reflect His love in every conversation. item.title: BUT GOD | Acts 2:22-24 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
In the message "But God," Pastor Steve Abraham shares the powerful message that no matter the "reality" of your struggles or mistakes, there is always a "reversal" found in the grace of God. He encourages us to remember that even when life feels like a dead end, God can step in and lead us through it. It's a thought-provoking call to trade our shame for a relationship with the risen Savior, reminding us that we are never too far gone for His love.
Watch this message on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AHUYJOcuqfo

item.title: No Plan B | Mark 1:16-20; John 1:40-42 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
In this stirring message, "No Plan B," Pastor Steve Abraham reminds us that we are God's chosen instruments to reach a hurting world. Drawing from the calling of the first disciples, we are challenged to move beyond the "huddle" of our church walls and embrace our divine mission to be fishers of people, sharing the hope and light of Jesus with everyone we encounter.

item.title: BOLD FAITH | Give Me This Mountain | Joshua 14:6-13 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
In this powerful message, Pastor Steve Abraham continues our BOLD FAITH series with a deep dive into Joshua 14:6-13. Caleb’s request to "Give Me This Mountain" wasn't just about land; it was a testament to 45 years of unwavering trust in God’s promises. If you are facing "giants" or waiting for your own promised land, this message provides three practical pillars to help you move forward in faith: WATCH YOUR WORDS – Caleb didn't speak from fear; he spoke from conviction. Learn how to align your speech with God’s truth over your life and family. STAND ON THE PROMISES – Character is built on our relationship with the Word. Discover how to navigate the "wait" with the right attitude. CONFRONT YOUR GIANTS – Stop tolerating generational cycles. It’s time to drive out the giants that stand between you and your spiritual inheritance. God isn't done with your story yet. We hope this message encourages you to step into everything He has for you. item.title: BOLD FAITH | Get It Out | Joshua 7:1-26 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
The message, titled "Get It Out," focuses on the biblical account of Achan in Joshua 7. After the victory at Jericho, Israel suffered a surprising defeat at the small city of Ai. This defeat was rooted in Achan’s secret sin—taking "devoted things" that belonged to God and hiding them in his tent. The sermon explores three critical truths about sin and its impact on our lives.
Watch this message on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TcuhYqbN58U
